title: docs: linkify plain-text podman-foo(1) references
body:
Closes #19701

Adds a Sphinx source-read hook alongside the existing convert_markdown_title that scans for plain-text references like podman-foo(1) and turns them into proper markdown links, but only when a matching podman-foo.1.md file exists under the docs/source/markdown. Reference to man pages that dont exist in the tree are left untouched, and references already inside a markdown link are skipped so they don't get double wrapped.

Tested locally with 'make html' command :
- podman-run(1) in podman-auto-update.1.md correctly resolves to a link
- podman-container-inspect(1) in podman-events.1.md correctly resolves to a link.
- podman-create(1) in podman-remote.1.md (already which is a manual link) was left alone and untouched.
- podman-play-kube(1) in podman-kube-apply.1.md (no matching files are exists) was correctly left as plain text.
